subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should #38364 remain the combined tracker, or should maintainers accept #90745/equivalent for structured reply metadata and route final/no-output semantics to #87561?
rationale: Current main has partial UI and runtime-context pieces, but the permanent contract boundary spans Control UI, Gateway protocol, agent runtime context, and channel delivery semantics.

options.title: Split by existing owners
options.body: Use #90745 or a maintainer replacement for structured reply metadata, keep #87561 as the final-fallback delivery contract, and close #38364 only once both are represented.

options.title: Keep combined tracker
options.body: Leave #38364 open as the cross-surface Control UI output-state umbrella until both reply metadata and no-output UX are implemented together.

options.title: Defer reply metadata contract
options.body: Treat the current Markdown quote UI as sufficient for now and keep only the broader final-fallback issue open.

recommendation.title: Split by existing owners
recommendation.body: Use #90745 or a maintainer replacement for structured reply metadata, keep #87561 as the final-fallback delivery contract, and close #38364 only once both are represented.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision is centered on runtime-context contract shape, with adjacent Control UI and agent-runtime history in current main.
